body:
Someone's anger shows up for everyone's battles except their own.

They advocate fiercely for the colleague, the sibling, the stranger, then freeze at the personal equivalent, and everyone can see the pattern except the person running it.

With Mars square Chiron, people need a fight they are allowed to have, and the personal one got ruled out of bounds long ago.

Their courage and their avoidance run on the same fuel.

The advocacy may be completely genuine, but it also works as a detour, and the personal fight tends to stay unfought until its owner chooses it on purpose.
